name: Chatfield's / Terrasoul Organic Carob Powder (Caffeine-Free Cocoa Alternative)
whyItWorks: Roasted pod powder that mimics chocolate flavor without caffeine, theobromine, or oxalic acid. Does not stimulate colonic motor complexes or irritate gastric sphincters like cocoa does.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 1 tablespoon into warm oat milk with a dash of maple syrup for a soothing, gut-safe 'hot chocolate'.
